name: dsfd_vm_write_payload_native
structural_change: Registered native write edge: the scalar 29,203-sink W0/wsched register becomes 150 independently clocked actual leaves (control1/header1/payload4/dispatch16/stage128) with every leaf boundary a pin register or output flop (native pin rule; measured: lane 34-level in->out TT -1119 ps, then 16-level in->reg -204 ps; stage drain combinational pin-to-pin). Fixed edges: W0 P/P+1, control lane P+1, dispatch P+2/P+3, storage P+4, drain pin P+4+c, output P+5+c, scatter P+6+c (+2 cycles vs r8); no ready/credit. Pins on closed-leaf M5/M4 tracks; outhold off.
